 ORDER
This is first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicant for grant of bail.

T he applicant is in custody since 09.10.2023 in connection with Crime No.333/2023, registered at P.S. - Laur, District- Rewa (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(1), 376(2)(n), and 342 of the IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

Prosecution story in short is that on 10.09.2023 father of prosecutrix went to his agricultural field at that time his daughter told her grand mother and father to answer call of nature and went away from house and did not return back.
After search she was not found.
On the report offence under Section 363 of IPC has been registered.
On 13.09.2023 prosecutrix appeared n the police station Laur, District Rewa.

sentences.text: Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 was registered against the applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
She was consenting party as she went with the applicant on her own will.
In the medical report also there is no definite opinion regarding rape.
Appellant is custody since 09.10.2023.
Charge sheet has been filed and trial will take considerable time.
On the basis of aforesaid, it is prayed to enlarge the applicant on bail
Learned
Panel Lawyer for the State strongly opposed the application of the applicant.
It is submitted that as per the statement of proseuctrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. she has stated against the present applicant that he committed rape with her.
Prosecutrix was aged about 13 years 6 months at the time of incident.
Therefore, it is prayed that bail may not be granted to the present applicant.

After considering overall the facts and circumstances of the case, the prosecutrix was a minor girl and the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.PC, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to applicant.
Therefore, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicant is dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE anu Promins Singh Baghel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146357760/
